cases.title: Leaky column (known name)
cases.expected_behavior: Detect fraud_probability as leakage, never train on it, report an honest (low) holdout PR-AUC.

cases.title: Leaky column (renamed upstream)
cases.expected_behavior: Same leak under a new name (vendor_risk_score): detection must come from evidence, not a hard-coded list.

cases.title: Balanced, clean data (Titanic)
cases.expected_behavior: No imbalance -> skip the threshold tuner; reach a solid holdout F1.

cases.title: Imbalanced data with real signal
cases.expected_behavior: Detect imbalance, use the tuner, find a model family that beats logistic regression.

cases.title: Junk strings in a numeric column
cases.expected_behavior: Validator flags numeric contamination in f3, repair coerces it, run completes with good F1.

cases.title: 8% duplicated rows
cases.expected_behavior: Detect and drop duplicate rows before splitting (otherwise copies leak into the holdout).

cases.title: 1.5% invalid target labels
cases.expected_behavior: Quarantine rows whose label is not 0/1 instead of crashing.

cases.title: Training worker fails 3 times
cases.expected_behavior: Retry failed fits, route around the failure and still finish with a good model.

cases.title: No signal: do not waste the budget
cases.expected_behavior: Nothing beats ~3% PR-AUC; detect the plateau and stop early instead of spending all 8 experiments.
